Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

RobustSandwichRV 0.5.0

  • Added version-pinned GitHub installation instructions and a runnable demo("quick-start") with a practitioner-oriented explanation of the table.
  • Added fixed Bartlett and quadratic-spectral HAC, including article aliases HAC_Bartlett_L4 and HAC_QS_BW5, frozen row ordering and explicit bandwidths.
  • Added raw two-way CR0/CR1 via TWCR0_raw, TWCR1_raw and a rule constructor. CR1 preserves separate component corrections and the actual residual df.
  • Extended all three current RV estimands, benchmark deletion refits, independent covariance evaluation and validate_sandwich_reference() to these rules.
  • Added a continuous signed-form lower envelope for indefinite operators and signed-quadratic direction optimization/root finding. Nonpositive target variances are rejected, with no PSD repair.
  • Full current-article validation now covers all 112 cases and all estimators.

RobustSandwichRV 0.2.0

  • Added rv_sand() for unrestricted scalar-index loss robustness, with an analytical continuous-envelope lower bound and independently refitted uppers.
  • Added rv_cal() with restoring-increment and strength-dependent profile calibration from the current manuscript, allowing every positive ratio below the cap. Direct fixed caps are also supported.
  • Added rv_benchmarks() retaining all signed deletion increments, common-chi corrections, partial R-squared values and binding controls. Empty, incomplete and complete-zero pools are distinguished. Blocks are not rank-normalized in the new increment calibration; the profile requires scalar benchmarks.
  • Added sandwich_rv() and a four-row practitioner table on a common test cutoff.
  • Retained the legacy point and symmetric-band APIs for compatibility.

RobustSandwichRV 0.1.0

  • Initial pure-R implementation.
  • Added classical, HC0, HC1, CR0, and CR1 scalar-confounder evaluation.
  • Added protected-first, diagonal-first, and full point-conditioned workflows.
  • Added benchmark-bounded calibration with certified lower and upper bounds.
  • Added scalar and rank-normalized grouped observed-control benchmarks.
  • Added explicit full-regression witness validation and nested-band reuse.
  • Added two-direction reduction for arbitrary omitted-confounder blocks.
  • Added frozen cross-language numerical fixtures, sensemakr comparison, and sandwich covariance validation.
